content.value: Three 100 x 200 mm cylinder concrete specimens prepared from the same batch (08) were crushed under uniaxial compressive loads of 265 kN, 270 kN and 262 kN. Calculate the average compressive strength of concrete and also predict the minimum flexural failure load with the size of 100 x 100 x 500 mm prism which made from the same batch of cylinder specimens.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
